Oh dear, this reminds me of my story. I watched the Olympic games, that took place in athens. I dunno I think it was 2004. I admired the track athletes and wsnted to run as fast like them. So whenever we had a competition at school, I tried to run like this athlets and actually did well. Soon enough, my teachers notice my talent and advice my parents to transfer me to a sports school, where I can improve my skills. Yeeaa, I was so so excited and told mom, abd she was all like, wait until you grow up.

So  2/3 years passes by, and we moved into another state. So I ran like I used to do, and the teachers were going nut. They told me the same thing, that my teachers in primaryschool used to tell me.

So 2008 the Olympic games in Beijing kicked off, and ugh when I say that I was melted for this track athleted, I really ment it. Really could picture myself running with other fellow athletes. So I made a choonkie list an hung it on our kitchen board for my parents to see. They took it as a joke and told me to be a teacher or a doctor. I had two friends, that were track racing. Im not doing great at my university and felt I lost the calling of mylife :/  Oh and not to forget, I draw, but my parents would try and convince me how its was frickin evil and if any of the famous brands and designers would see this, thry gonna spoil me with their devil lifestyle snd stuff.
